title: Actual scalar-extension functor on raw integral rationalizations
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations; regard $E_T$ as an $A_T$-algebra through the canonical isomorphism $A_T\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,A))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] followed by postcomposition with the inclusion $A\subset E$. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ be the archived module-object category of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], identified with sectionwise modules by [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]. The actual scalar extension $F_T=E_T\otimes^L_{A_T}-$ on ambient module derived categories is exact and left adjoint to exact restriction of scalars. It carries $\mathcal I_T$ into $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ and induces an exact $E$-linear functor $J_T:\mathcal R_T\to\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ with $J_TK=F_TK$ and $J_T(u/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_T(u)$. The ambient scalar-extension unit is the derived image of $m\mapsto1\otimes m$. No full faithfulness or essential surjectivity is asserted.
